spec.purpose: Read-only MoE down consumer interval audit, default off, using one new MoE DLL in both arms. Snapshot the original selected weighted BF16 ranges and original residual before correction, then compare every corrected range, VT4 sum, shared merge and full unrounded F32 output against the actual production combine in all40 MoE calls. The observer never skips replay or supplies inference values. Both arms must match the original8192 prompt, all512 GB10 output IDs, first logit within0.125 and actual streaming callbacks. policy.raw_interval_source: Unchanged empirical weighted PPB Cauchy envelope union both BF16 neighbors; at most nine BF16 endpoints.

scope: Two fresh real-model q8192/out512 processes use the same new MoE DLL, fixed mode0 whole-provider DLL, retained CK/FLA/CLI/AOT artifacts and original prompt/GB10 oracle. The sole environment difference enables a read-only observer. It snapshots pre-replay selected weighted contribution ranges and original residual, observes every actual selected down replay, waits for the original shared expert, then checks every corrected VT4 sum, proposed fixed routed/shared-combined endpoint, full unrounded residual and actual production F32 output. Original producer, selector, expert order, replay and combine remain unchanged. Every original output and callback ID and first-logit tolerance0.125 are attached. The interval is conditional on the existing empirical producer envelope; this same-case audit is not a universal hardware error proof. Its TTFT includes observation, atomics, allocations, transfers and completion. It omits no replay and demonstrates no performance saving. No prefix, long-context, package or release qualification follows.

decision.decision: Keep this observer default off. Implement a separate default-off actual consumer filter: a fixed combined BF16 endpoint certifies the full unrounded residual, allowing selected routed-down replay to be omitted as a group. Retain original replay for every uncertified cell. The existing shared-done event is already recorded before routed launches, so the full consumer can be checked with an explicit same-call device dependency. Product success and net timing must be measured separately.
limits: All selected corrections still run in this pair; no replay removal or saving is measured.
The empirical projection envelope is checked against every actually replayed selected endpoint here, but this does not prove a universal hardware bound.
TTFT remains above10000 ms; retained performance, long contexts and release remain unqualified.
